0. FOREWORD
0.1 This Indian

Standard ( Part 13 ) was adopted b the Bureau of Indian Standards on 25 September 1987, after the draft gnaked by the Co-ordinating Committee on Materials for Automobiles had been approved by the Stuctural and Metals Division Couxicil.

0.2 Part 1 of this standard was published in 1979 which. coyerg the chemical composition ef 33 rationalized iteels. The me&u&al properties,. hardenability. and isothermal transformation characteristics of these 33 rationalized steels are being covered in different parts of this standard ( Parts 2 to 34 ). The data concerning these properties given in this standard is only for guidance and informatien puIpOSCS. 0.3 For the purpose of deciding whether a patiicular rcqulrement of this standard is domplied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be roundedoff in accordance with IS : 2 - 1960*. The number of significant places retained in the rodnded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

1. SCOPE 1.1 This standard ( Part 13 ) covers the mechanical properties and isothermal transformation characteristics of 4OClSS12 grade of steel for use by automobile and ancillary industry.
